name: Sound Wave Explorer
description: Freely adjust the frequency and amplitude of a point sound source. Observe how the spherical wave propagates; higher frequency produces denser wave arcs (shorter wavelength).

successCriteria.description: Notice that increasing frequency makes the wave arcs denser
Notice that amplitude controls the brightness of the wave pattern

hints.message: Drag the Frequency slider to see wavelength change in real time
Higher frequency = shorter wavelength (denser arcs). Lower frequency = longer wavelength (sparser arcs).

inquiryTask.question: 改变声音的频率，观察球面波的疏密变化，频率与波长有什么关系？

steps.instruction: 把频率调到 200Hz，观察波弧的疏密并点击「记录本次实验」。
steps.hint: 注意左上角信息卡的波长数值

steps.instruction: 把频率调到 600Hz、1000Hz，各记录一次。
steps.hint: 对比不同频率下的波长

steps.instruction: 归纳：频率增大时波长如何变化？

inquiryTask.referenceConclusion: 频率与波长成反比：λ = v / f。频率越高，波长越短，波弧越密；频率越低，波长越长，波弧越疏。
